project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 2 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment reviewed 2026-08-12: 4 of 6 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; uncaptured or unresolved entries are retained as unknown and listed in the county audit.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Ditton Priors qualifies as a local detour through Ditton Priors Local History Centre and CHURCH OF ST JOHN THE BAPTIST. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Ditton Priors: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Ditton Priors offers Ditton Priors Local History Centre, CHURCH OF ST JOHN THE BAPTIST within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Ditton Priors Local History Centre
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Ditton Priors Local History Centre and CHURCH OF ST JOHN THE BAPTIST, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.

dontMiss: CHURCH OF ST JOHN THE BAPTIST
